sabbath.title: We gather on the seventh day to study the scriptures.
sabbath.body: IOG meets each Sabbath for ordered bible study, reading doctrine through the law, the prophets, Christ, and the apostles.

foundation.title: Built upon the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief cornerstone.
foundation.body: IOG is a Sabbath bible study community teaching the uncut word of God according to the prophets and the apostles. We observe the Lord's Sabbath, the feast days of Leviticus 23, the dietary law of Leviticus 11, and the royal law of the Ten Commandments.

feasts.title: Sacred time, appointed in scripture.
feasts.body: Observances appointed in Leviticus 23, marked on the calendar of 2026.
feasts.note: Observances follow scripture and traditional reckoning. Service times are listed in Central and Eastern time.

visit.title: Weekly Sabbath Class
visit.description: Visitor information for the weekly Sabbath class at Israel of God, including what to expect, what to bring, dress order, and visit planning.
visit.expectTitle: What to expect on the Sabbath
visit.expectBody: The weekly class is orderly, scriptural, and practical. Visitors are received for study, listening, and fellowship with the assembly.
visit.conductTitle: Approach the class in modesty and order.
visit.conductBody: Dress and conduct should reflect reverence in the assembly. The following guidance is observed in the building during class.
visit.dressTitle: Modest apparel is required for men and women.
visit.dressBody: These requirements are shared plainly so visitors can arrive prepared and without uncertainty.
visit.requestTitle: Tell IOG you are planning to attend.
visit.requestBody: This helps the class receive visitors with clarity, especially if you have questions about timing, accessibility, or family attendance.

media.studyDescription: A reverent class setting for scripture, order, and fellowship.
media.dressDescription: Respectful attire for gathering before the God of Israel.

whatToExpectItems: Opening prayer and ordered scripture reading.
Teaching led by the teaching elder with brothers reading the Bible.
Fellowship after class with brothers and sisters in Christ.
visit.fellowshipNote: After class, bring your lunch and fellowship with your brothers and sisters in Christ.
dressCodeMen: Remove any head covering upon entering and while in the building.
Do not wear sleeveless shirts, short pants, tight-fitting pants, fleece jogging pants, or revealing pants.
Younger brothers should wear belts, pull pants to the waist, tuck shirts in, and wear overall straps on the shoulders if wearing overalls.
dressCodeWomen: Do not wear pants, shorts, skorts, mini or tight-fitting bottoms, halter tops, or revealing splits.

giving.title: Honour the Lord with thy Substance
giving.description: Giving at IOG is handled in seriousness, gratitude, and order. The support of the work is received without spectacle and with plainness before God.
giving.mandateTitle: The storehouse is supplied in obedience, not performance.
giving.mandateBody: Giving is not treated as display, pressure, or spectacle. It is approached as an act of order before God, according to the word and for the sake of the house.
giving.workTitle: Support is directed toward the poor and the maintenance of the house.
giving.workBody1: What is given is meant to strengthen the practical life of the assembly: the keeping of the place, the continuance of the work, and the relief of need where need is present.
giving.workBody2: IOG keeps this matter plain. Stewardship is handled with seriousness so that the work may remain in order and the house may not lack what is necessary.

membership.title: The Foundation of the Prophets
membership.description: Membership at IOG is received as a covenant matter. It joins doctrine, order, and fellowship under the word taught by the prophets, the apostles, and Christ the chief cornerstone.
membership.covenantTitle: Those received are no longer strangers, but fellow citizens in the household.
membership.covenantBody: Membership is not casual subscription. It is an ordered request to walk in fellowship, repentance, and obedience within the household that confesses the God of Israel.
membership.observancesTitle: Membership is kept within a visible order of doctrine and practice.
membership.observancesBody: These pillars mark the life of the assembly and form the expected frame of covenant continuity at IOG.
membership.preparationTitle: This is a serious act of repentance and dedication to the God of Israel.
membership.preparationBody1: A membership request should be made soberly. It is a declaration that a person desires to be received under the doctrine, judgments, statutes, and fellowship observed in this assembly.
membership.preparationBody2: IOG does not treat membership as a casual subscription. It is approached with truthfulness, prayer, and a willingness to be examined in the light of the word.

dietary.label: The Dietary Law
dietary.value: Clean and unclean according to Leviticus 11.

royal.label: The Royal Commandments
royal.value: The moral law, judgments, statutes, and doctrine.

prayer.title: The Prayer of the Righteous
prayer.description: Requests brought here are handled with sobriety, compassion, and care. Intercession is approached as a serious labor before God, not as public display.
prayer.mandateTitle: Prayer is shared so the body may bear, confess, and seek healing together.
prayer.mandateBody: IOG receives prayer requests as matters of intercession, repentance, and mutual care. What is brought before the Lord should be brought truthfully, with reverence and with faith.
prayer.burdensTitle: The elder and the assembly intercede so burdens need not be carried alone.
prayer.burdensBody: The teaching elder receives prayer requests with discretion, and the assembly joins where appropriate in collective intercession. This work is meant to comfort the afflicted, strengthen the weary, and bring matters before the Lord in an ordered spirit.
prayer.formTitle: Submit your request carefully and it will be received in confidence.
prayer.formBody: Leave your name only if you wish. If a response is needed, provide an email address so the elder may reply in order.
prayer.note: Prayer requests are received carefully. Confidential requests are held for elder attention only.

contact.title: Write with clarity and IOG will be able to respond in order.
contact.body: Use the form for introductions, practical questions, or requests for further information about the Sabbath class and the work.
contact.heroDescription: Send a careful inquiry to the assembly and a brother will respond when able.
